answer:
Top priority: your stool test (FIT) on 2025-11-04 was positive, and I can't find any follow-up in your records: no colonoscopy, no referral, no note about it. A positive FIT should be followed by a colonoscopy, usually within a few months, so please raise this first.

Other things to discuss:
- Cholesterol: in February 2025 your LDL was 131 and total cholesterol 212 (both high). Atorvastatin 20 mg was recorded the same month, but there's no cholesterol test since, so we don't know if it is working. With diabetes at your age, a repeat lipid panel is due.
- Diabetes: your A1c has come down from 8.3% (Jan 2025) to 7.6, 7.1 and 6.9% (Feb 2026), which is good. But the last A1c is about 8 months old, so one is due. Your kidney tests (creatinine, eGFR 73 to 69) are normal but slowly drifting down, worth rechecking. I see no urine albumin test, eye exam or foot exam in the records, which are usually done yearly in diabetes.
- Medicines: metformin was recorded as stopped on 2024-04-15, and Jardiance 10 mg and atorvastatin are listed as active. Records don't say why metformin stopped, so ask whether that was intended.
- Chest pain episode in July 2025: the CT scan showed no pulmonary embolism and the chest wall pain resolved. The CT mentioned mild degenerative changes of the thoracic spine, which is minor, but you can ask about it. Nothing more is needed unless symptoms return.
- Vaccines and screening: no immunizations are recorded at all (flu, COVID, pneumococcal, shingles, tetanus), and no mammogram or bone density result. These may simply be held elsewhere, so check and bring any records.
short: Positive stool test (FIT) on 2025-11-04 with no colonoscopy or follow-up on record; also due: lipid recheck (LDL 131 in Feb 2025 on new statin), A1c (last 6.9% Feb 2026), diabetes eye/foot/urine checks, and vaccines.
